scripts.dev:web: cd apps/web && bun x next dev
scripts.build: bun run build:schemas && bun run build:agent-core && bun run build:cli && bun run build:web
scripts.build:cli: cd apps/cli && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/gitpulse --target bun
scripts.build:web: cd apps/web && bun x next build --webpack
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:schemas && bun run typecheck:agent-core && bun run typecheck:cli && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.test: bun run test:schemas && bun run test:agent-core && bun run test:web
scripts.test:llm: cd packages/agent-core && bun test src/agent.test.ts src/llm/config.test.ts
scripts.start:web: cd apps/web && bun x next start
